_comment: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA — This protocol is entirely fictitious and is used solely for the IBM Bob AI Hackathon TrialGuard demo. It does not represent any real clinical trial, compound, or patient population.
title: Phase II Study of Compound XR-447 in Advanced Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer

inclusion_criteria.description: Patient age must be between 18 and 75 years (inclusive) at time of enrollment
inclusion_criteria.rationale: Compound XR-447 has not been studied in pediatric or elderly populations beyond age 75 due to altered drug metabolism

inclusion_criteria.description: ECOG Performance Status of 0, 1, or 2 at screening
inclusion_criteria.rationale: Patients with ECOG PS 3-4 are unlikely to tolerate study treatment and may confound safety assessments

inclusion_criteria.description: Confirmed histological or cytological diagnosis of advanced NSCLC (Stage IIIB or IV)
inclusion_criteria.rationale: Eligibility requires confirmed NSCLC diagnosis prior to enrollment

inclusion_criteria.description: Adequate bone marrow function: Absolute Neutrophil Count >= 1.5 x 10^9/L at screening
inclusion_criteria.rationale: ANC below threshold indicates bone marrow insufficiency incompatible with chemotherapy administration

inclusion_criteria.description: Signed and dated Informed Consent Form (ICF) prior to any study-related procedure
inclusion_criteria.rationale: GCP ICH E6 requirement: consent must precede all study procedures

exclusion_criteria.description: Prior treatment with any EGFR/ALK inhibitor within 28 days before enrollment
exclusion_criteria.rationale: Prior targeted therapy may confound efficacy assessments and increase toxicity risk

exclusion_criteria.description: Active uncontrolled systemic infection at time of enrollment
exclusion_criteria.rationale: Active infection would confound safety assessments and may worsen with immunosuppressive study treatment

exclusion_criteria.description: Pregnancy or breastfeeding at time of enrollment
exclusion_criteria.rationale: Compound XR-447 is teratogenic in animal models; not to be administered to pregnant or nursing women

visit_schedule.name: Screening
visit_schedule.description: Screening visit to confirm eligibility. Must occur within 14 days before Day 1.

visit_schedule.name: Baseline / Day 1
visit_schedule.description: First dose administration. Window is tight (±1 day) due to dosing schedule dependency.

visit_schedule.name: Cycle 1 Day 15
visit_schedule.description: Mid-cycle safety check. AE review is mandatory.

visit_schedule.name: Cycle 1 End / Efficacy Assessment
visit_schedule.description: End-of-cycle efficacy and safety assessment. Tumor assessment is the primary endpoint measurement.

lab_thresholds.action_required: Dose hold; notify Principal Investigator immediately
lab_thresholds.rationale: Hemoglobin < 8.0 g/dL indicates severe anemia requiring dose modification per protocol Section 7.3
ANC < 1.0 x10^9/L indicates Grade 3 neutropenia; dosing must be suspended per protocol Section 7.3

lab_thresholds.action_required: Document and monitor; consider dose reduction if persistent
lab_thresholds.rationale: Creatinine > 1.5 mg/dL may indicate impaired renal function affecting drug clearance

lab_thresholds.action_required: Document; repeat in 2 weeks; notify PI if > 3x ULN
lab_thresholds.rationale: ALT elevation may indicate hepatotoxicity; must be monitored per protocol Section 7.4

lab_thresholds.action_required: Dose hold; assess for bleeding risk; notify PI
lab_thresholds.rationale: Platelet count < 75 x10^9/L indicates Grade 3 thrombocytopenia; dosing suspended per Section 7.3

dosing_rules.description: Study drug must be administered within a 4-hour window of a meal (within 2 hours before or 2 hours after eating)
dosing_rules.rationale: Bioavailability of Compound XR-447 is significantly impaired when taken in a fasted state

dosing_rules.description: Maximum allowed dose delay: study drug must not be delayed more than 3 days from scheduled dosing date without PI notification and protocol deviation documentation
dosing_rules.rationale: Dose delays > 3 days may compromise treatment efficacy and require formal deviation documentation

dosing_rules.description: Dose reduction must be documented in source documents and eCRF within 48 hours of occurrence
dosing_rules.rationale: GCP requires timely documentation of dose modifications to ensure data integrity

reporting_rules.description: Serious Adverse Events (SAEs) must be reported to the Sponsor within 24 hours of the investigator becoming aware of the event
reporting_rules.rationale: ICH E6 GCP Section 4.11.1 and regulatory requirement: SAE reporting within 24 hours is mandatory. Late reporting is a critical finding in FDA inspections.

reporting_rules.description: Protocol deviations must be documented within 5 business days of discovery
reporting_rules.rationale: Timely documentation of deviations supports audit trail integrity per ICH E6

severity_definitions.Major: A deviation that may have a direct impact on patient safety, the rights or well-being of the subject, the validity of the study data, or the conduct of the study in compliance with GCP. Requires immediate CAPA.
severity_definitions.Minor: A deviation from the protocol that is unlikely to have a significant effect on patient safety or data integrity but departs from the approved protocol. Requires documentation and monitoring.
severity_definitions.Administrative: A procedural or documentation deviation with no clinical impact. Requires documentation but no formal CAPA unless recurring.
